prompts.name: mongodb-installation-production-banner.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one premium enterprise MongoDB technical article banner, EXACT 1000x1000 pixels square. Deep charcoal and midnight green background, MongoDB green highlights, clean modern datacenter/DevOps style. No people, no Persian text. Central elegant MongoDB leaf-style emblem above a database cylinder surrounded by a Linux server rack, terminal window, three replica nodes, security shield and monitoring graph icons. Clear sophisticated editorial typography, spacious composition. Exact English title: 'MongoDB Installation & Production Deployment'. Exact subtitle: 'Secure • Replicated • Production Ready'. All visible text English only. Beautiful restrained isometric infrastructure artwork with crisp readable typography. Save a local PNG artifact and return its file path.

prompts.name: mongodb-architecture.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create one enterprise technical MongoDB Architecture infographic, target 1920x1080 pixels, wide 16:9. All text English only, no people. Deep charcoal/dark green background, MongoDB green accents, premium clean DevOps datacenter style with isometric server and database icons, very readable labels. Title 'MongoDB Architecture'. Show exactly six connected stages with arrows LEFT TO RIGHT in this order: 'Application' -> 'MongoDB Driver' -> 'MongoDB Server' -> 'Database' -> 'Collections' -> 'Documents'. First three are connection flow, latter three are nested data model, distinguish this with an understated 'Data Model' bracket. Add an Authentication lock gate between MongoDB Driver and MongoDB Server, label 'Authentication' and 'Port 27017 / TCP'. Small structured BSON card by Documents. Crisp accurate clean layout, generous whitespace. Output a local PNG file.

prompts.name: mongodb-security-architecture.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. One professional technical infographic PNG target 1920x1080 wide 16:9, English only, no people. Title 'MongoDB Security Architecture'. Premium clean datacenter/DevOps style, dark charcoal and MongoDB green. Main allowed flow 'Application Server' -> 'Firewall' -> 'MongoDB Server' with arrows, lock and green shield, TLS label. Separate red 'Public Internet' cloud with red blocked icon and red line stopped BEFORE MongoDB; label 'Blocked: Public Access'. Six clearly readable security layer labels in balanced cards: 'Authentication', 'TLS', 'Firewall', 'bindIp', 'Least Privilege', 'Management Network'. Show private application subnet and private management subnet visually. No public connection reaching the server. Small label 'TCP 27017 • Private Network Only'. Spacious polished technically accurate composition.

prompts.name: mongodb-replica-set.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. One enterprise MongoDB replica set technical infographic, target 1920x1080 wide 16:9, English only, no people. Dark charcoal and MongoDB green modern clean isometric datacenter style. Title 'MongoDB Replica Set'. Exactly three equal server nodes: left 'mongo01' with 'PRIMARY' and '10.10.20.11'; center 'mongo02' with 'SECONDARY' and '10.10.20.12'; right 'mongo03' with 'SECONDARY' and '10.10.20.13'. Show green data replication arrows from mongo01 to each secondary labeled 'Replication'. Above, Application and MongoDB Driver, client writes arrow to primary. Footer 'Replica Set: rs0'. Three separate concise callouts: 'Automatic Election', 'Automatic Failover', 'Majority Voting'. Show '2 of 3 votes' callout for voting quorum and a dashed alternate election path without implying multi-primary writes. Highly legible labels, balanced whitespace, no extraneous prose.

prompts.name: mongodb-backup-monitoring.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. One professional enterprise MongoDB Backup & Monitoring Architecture infographic, PNG target 1920x1080 wide 16:9. English only, no people, dark charcoal and MongoDB green modern clean datacenter DevOps style. Title 'MongoDB Backup & Monitoring'. Center-left MongoDB replica/database servers. FOUR INDEPENDENT PARALLEL routes branching from MongoDB, do not make a linear chain: green data route to 'Backup Server' labeled 'Encrypted Backups'; telemetry route to 'MongoDB Exporter' then 'Prometheus / Grafana'; telemetry route to 'Zabbix'; diagnostic log route to 'Syslog' labeled 'Centralized Logs'. Distinguish backup data, monitoring metrics, and logs by separate visual lanes. Bottom row exactly six metric labels with clean icons: 'CPU', 'RAM', 'Disk', 'Queries', 'Connections', 'Replication Lag'. Subtle small backup callout 'Restore Testing • Retention • Recovery'. Spacious accurate readable technical presentation.
